thread:
marie: Heads-up — invoice INV-2026-045 (acct 5821) is stuck on hold for EU reverse-charge. Customer uploaded a resale certificate scan but our OCR normalized name to "ACME CORP S.A." while VIES returns "ACME CORPORATION SA". VAT ID: DE123456789. PO: PO-7731. Can billing/compliance do a manual override or confirm what extra docs we need?

ivan: Thanks — can you paste the raw OCR snippet and the VIES response? I can kick off a manual review but need the exact evidence to attach. Also tagging @sarah from compliance.

marie: Sure — OCR snippet (from the PDF image):
```
NAME: ACME CORP S.A.
ADDRESS: Hauptstr. 12, 10115 Berlin
VAT: DE123456789
```
And VIES lookup returned:```
VIES response: {"vat_status":"VALID","name":"ACME CORPORATION SA","country_code":"DE","vat_number":"123456789"}```

ola: FYI the auto-rule flags name mismatches even for small punctuation/abbrev diffs. We run a fuzzy-compare (levenshtein) threshold and this one falls outside allowed delta because of "Corp" vs "Corporation" plus punctuation. The VAT ID itself is VALID per VIES so this is probably a naming variant.

vat-bot: Automated VIES lookup log for DE123456789 — timestamp 2024-07-18T10:03:12Z — status: VALID — reported name: ACME CORPORATION SA — confidence: N/A.

ivan: Ok — two paths: 1) quick manual override for this invoice if compliance approves, or 2) ask customer for an additional evidence doc (company registry extract or a signed resale certificate with legal name). Which do we prefer?

marie: Customer says they only have the same PDF they uploaded. They can supply a national tax registration extract but it'll take a day. They asked if we can unblock billing urgently — they're blocked on a vendor payment.

sarah: I can approve a manual override if we attach additional context and a secondary evidence file. For now, please attach the OCR output, the VIES response, and a short justification note from the CS rep explaining why this appears to be the same legal entity (aka variant of name). I also need a scan of the company registration or a bank statement showing the VAT ID within 48 hours to keep the override.

ivan: Got it. Marie — please add the justification note to the ticket and mark invoice as exempt_pending_manual. I'll set a billing hold override that expires in 48h, pending compliance receipt. I'll also add the #billing-escalations tag and escalate to payments ops if the override is used.

marie: Done — added note and attached OCR/VIES logs to the support case. Update: customer uploaded a national tax extract PDF. Linking it to the case now.

sarah: Received the extract. Name matches the VAT entry sufficiently after normalization (we checked transliteration rules). Compliance approves manual override. Ivan, please complete release flow.

ivan: Release complete — invoice INV-2026-045 moved to exempt and sent to payments for processing. Marking the thread resolved. :thumbsup:

marie: Fantastic — passing to payments and closing the support ticket. Thanks everyone!
